notes: confidence (C), feasibility (F), reversibility (R) are 0-100 inputs to S = 0.35V + 0.25C + 0.20F + 0.20R. Tune thresholds per client; keep the file under version control.

rules.title: All-purpose cluster mostly idle
rules.action: Lower auto-termination, enable autoscaling with a small minimum, or move the workload to serverless.

rules.title: Job cluster over-provisioned
rules.action: Benchmark with half the workers or autoscaling; keep the change if runtime stays inside the SLA.

rules.title: Auto-termination disabled or too long
rules.action: Set auto-termination to 30-60 minutes through a cluster policy.

rules.title: Unsupported or old Databricks Runtime
rules.action: Upgrade to a current LTS runtime (Photon where available) after a regression run on a copy of the job.

rules.title: Scheduled job runs on all-purpose compute
rules.action: Move the job to job compute or serverless jobs; all-purpose DBUs are priced several times higher.

rules.title: High job failure rate
rules.action: Triage the top termination codes; add retries with back-off only after fixing the root cause.

rules.title: One task dominates job runtime
rules.action: Profile the slow task (Spark UI: skewed partitions, shuffle, UDFs); consider splitting or salting the key.

rules.title: Job runtime regressed
rules.action: Diff code, input volume and table layout between the two periods; check for data growth or a lost filter.

rules.title: Daily cost spike
rules.action: Confirm with the owner whether the increase is expected (backfill, new data); otherwise roll back the change.

rules.title: Spend without cost-center tag
rules.action: Add the cost_center tag (job, cluster or warehouse) and enforce it with a compute policy.

rules.title: Query scans whole table (no file pruning)
rules.action: Filter on clustered/partition columns, or add liquid clustering on the filter column; verify with EXPLAIN and the query profile.

rules.title: Query spills to disk
rules.action: Reduce shuffle width (pre-aggregate, prune columns), check join strategy, or use a larger warehouse size only for this query.

rules.title: Identical query re-executed without cache hits
rules.action: Materialise the result (materialized view or scheduled table) or fix the dashboard refresh interval.

rules.title: SQL warehouse queuing at capacity
rules.action: Raise max clusters (scaling) rather than size; separate ETL and BI traffic onto different warehouses.

rules.title: Delta table has many small files
rules.action: Run OPTIMIZE, enable predictive optimization or auto-compaction, and fix the writer that produces tiny files.

rules.title: SQL anti-pattern in a recurring query
rules.action: Rewrite: replace CROSS JOIN with an equi-join, turn year(col)=X into a range filter, project only needed columns, replace NOT IN (subquery) with NOT EXISTS; confirm with the query profile.

rules.title: Plain file copy running on Databricks
rules.action: Benchmark an ADF Copy activity or Azure Function landing files to ADLS against the current DBU cost; keep transformations on Databricks. Move only if total cost of ownership is lower.
